# RecenterWatchInstaller

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/Scene/FrameworkInstallers.cs#L635)

A watch on the left wrist the player holds their right hand on to put themselves back on the
last recenter point. The trainee's own way out of having drifted or turned in the play space.

## Methods

### Install(Transform) {#install-transform}

Puts this into the open scene.

Under the left visual hand's wrist bone, whatever was dropped on. The root of a visual
hand never moves - the solver places its wrist bone on the physics hand and the mesh
follows the bones - so anywhere else under the hand leaves the watch on the floor where
the rig was spawned, which is where the last one was found.

```csharp
public override GameObject Install(Transform parentOverride)
```

**Parameters**

| --- | --- | --- |
| `parentOverride` | [`Transform`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/Transform.html) | Ignored: the watch goes on the wrist. |

**Returns** [`GameObject`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/GameObject.html) - The object that was created, or null when nothing was.
